decision_register.latest: MIG-018: Local-authoritative minimal Public replacement; old Public is optional/unavailable and never a source for transfer

product_goal: One target URL, owner and Local confirmation, then connect an EMPTY Public (zero active/pending destination orders). Populate with existing Local→Public sync. No old-Public DB/media/order transfer and no mandatory old-host contact.

implemented.item: Actual R249 cumulative Public owner login and consent HTML (new or already-installed owner), same-origin JS, protected setup and signed receipt via R257
Local full-admin authenticated start/confirm/cancel action on the existing Connections page using server session and WebAction CSRF
One-time Local durable challenge and independently verified signed owner receipt, Local private MAC/CSRF keys, idempotent resume and cancel
Pinned exact R249/35IC 8 original migrations untouched; R256 0009 and R257 0010 preserved; newly served owner UI compiled into 242-file QA-only payload
Real disposable MariaDB across separate Local and Public schemas: owner login + signed receipt + Local approval + no cutover
Actually installed R249-derived Public: fresh setup/owner HTTP regression plus real kernel GET /move/approve + JS/CSS via nested base path
Allow owner approval to begin with destroyed/unreachable old Public: do not fetch old deployment binding; blank source instance identity permitted by attestation contract

pending.item: MIG-018 minimal Public destination validation: healthy configured destination with zero active/pending guest orders, without erasing database
Reuse normal Public pairing/re-enrollment to bind new destination after owner and Local confirmations; avoid creating a new universal data-transfer engine
Re-publish from Local via existing normal catalog/media/staff/availability sync; only switch traffic once first sync and health respond successfully; leave Local unchanged on failure
One clear acceptance warning: any old-Public-only unreceived guest orders cannot be recovered when old host is inaccessible
One decisive real-operator E2E: old Public unreachable; new empty Public under root/subfolder; verify menu and orders; failure preserves Local; ensure customer-facing QR points to new destination
Cumulative Local/Public source parity, updater compatibility, production release
Independent future Local-machine move/recovery, Windows runtime and Print Agent: NOT part of Public replacement MVP

next_action: Implement minimal destination-empty check + owner-authorized secure pairing on new Public, then call existing Local→Public full normal sync and confirm health before enabling guest intake. Keep old Public optional (can be fully offline). Do NOT implement old Public data migration, image transfer, pending-order reconciliation, or generic snapshot engine.
handoff: MIG-018 replaces the overbuilt R259→R260 data-transfer plan. On qa/sokna-r259-owner-approval-flow-20261116, old-Public deploymentBindingProbe was removed from public_move_begin; source_public_instance_id may be empty. R259 prior CI passed owner flow, but latest MIG-018 code changes require fresh decisive CI. Production remains blocked until minimal pairing/sync end-to-end.
excluded_by_mig018: Read or export a damaged/inaccessible old Public DB
Transfer old Public media, financial projections, pending guest orders or staff sessions
Backfill and reconcile old-versus-new Public histories
General-purpose cross-host Public database snapshot, restore, data migration and complex multi-stage recovery orchestrator
Block new Public connection solely because the old host cannot be contacted
accepted_limitation: Orders registered solely on the old Public and never delivered to Local may be unrecoverable. Operator sees one plain-language acknowledgement; existing Local orders remain the source of truth.
